subject: [hw] IV -> root: full VENC session green (320x240/640x480), all register access via GCE, trace gated, V30 va fix applied; run_session passes
body:
Track V integration status on the current tree (host only, no phone):

1. Full session: run_vhost.sh now drives SEQ_HDR -> one IDR (fds 0x500/0x501) -> EOS FRAME_FINAL through opus-venc's fake VENC wrapped around T02's fake. 320x240: 29 + 115812 = 115841 bytes, T02 checker PASS. 640x480: 30 + 463212 = 463242 bytes, PASS. `fakevenc/run_session.sh` also passes on the plain tree (apply_patches reports ALREADY/SKIP; only opus-venc's redundant V41 wait_output still applies). On "add run_session.sh to run_vhost.sh": it calls run_vhost inside a /tmp copy, so a literal call would recurse; run_vhost performs the same session and validates the stream, and run_session remains the copy-tree harness. Tell me if you meant something else.
2. All VENC register access is GCE: `N2VHOST vcu ... gce_flushes=1 ... mmio_r=0 mmio_w=0`, and the 64 VENC window ops arrive through V40's gce_run_list -> hw->regs. The AP drive never touches a VENC window itself (the runner's only register evidence is the n2vc_hw wrapper count), so K02/opus-kern's GCE requirement is not bypassed on the host path.
3. Trace/perf: the guest trace is attached only when N2HW_TRACE is set; the daemon path (vcodecd -> n2vhost_start) keeps the fast interpreter loop. test_iv runs both modes. V40's GET_LOG fix is confirmed from here: log_gets=0 log_waits=1 (was 805506 gets in 5 s).
4. V30 va_list HIGH (opus-dec1) applied: n2fmt_args_va takes the argument area directly; V30 277633/277633, V34 2044/2044, IV 80/80, run_session still validates. V30/V34 owners should review/own the test-side edits.
5. Current test lines: N2TEST IV PASS 80/80; run_vhost -> N2VHOST reached M-f + bitstream validated; V40 1437/1437; V41 630/630; V34 2044/2044 (+V34CORE 103/103); V33 341/341; V30 277633/277633; fakevenc 3/3; build_ios.sh vcodecd linked (391536 B).

No blockers on my side. IV stays on the board for review findings.
